edit_rules: Changing the uniform thickness parameter updates both the wall width and the floor height simultaneously.
Changing the outer dimensions (60, 40, 20) updates the outer envelope; the inner cavity adjusts to maintain the specified uniform thickness.
Changing the corner radius (R6) updates both outer and inner corner radii to maintain concentricity.
